title: Teppan Grilled Nectarine Salad
description: A sweet and savory salad featuring grilled nectarines, crunchy jointed chicken, and a hint of Mexican flavor.

ingredients.name: jointed chicken breast
ingredients.notes: marinated in lime juice and spices

instructions: Marinate jointed chicken breast in lime juice and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Grill chicken breast on teppan until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per side.
In a large bowl, combine mixed greens salad and sliced nectarines.
Grill tortilla strips on teppan until crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Shred Mexican cheese blend and sprinkle on top of salad.
Drizzle lime juice and olive oil on top of salad.
Garnish with grilled tortilla strips and serve immediately.
